ablation.why: The dominant term for this capability. Dropping it leaves a live background (other modules still seat on approve/holiday) while removing the vocabulary bridge to the leave handlers — which is the gap a structural channel is supposed to close.

hold.why: seated in BOTH arms (143 -> 113). S4 must not cost it its seats: a channel that pushes the module that owns the capability out of the selection has moved noise in, not signal.

stayEmpty.why: zero-signal in BOTH arms, pool=0 under the FULL vocabulary. Its only route matching /leave|holiday|approv/i is POST /consent/approve -> OAuthConsentApprovePOST, an OAuth consent grant: the regex matches, the domain does not. If S4 seats anything here, the route channel is matching on the word rather than on the capability.

notPinned.wcp_review_service: Deliberately unclassified. It flips candidates-no-seat -> zero-signal under ablation, which would make an attractive module-level flip target, but its one regex match is POST /:promotion_id/application/:application_id -> Approve: a real approval workflow, for promotions rather than leave. Whether it belongs to 请假管理 is a judgement about the product, and pinning it wrongly is expensive in both directions — as stay-empty it would score a correct S4 recall as a false positive, as flip it would demand a recall that may be wrong. Fable ruled: when unsure, do not pin.

budgetsNote: maxGraphQueries is pinned generously (400) rather than at the production default. It is a CAP, so a larger value changes no selection — but the budget travels in the attribution identity, so a value that later has to be raised would move the baseline for a reason unrelated to recall. S4 adds route-inventory queries; the headroom is there so that slice moves the flip set and nothing else. Two features over five modules already exceeds 70.
profileNote: Only the ablated arm carries hypotheses; the full arm stays a pure lexical control. pathPattern is the inventory's own routePath verbatim — these are gin group-relative paths, and writing the public full path would align against nothing. Adding the profile changes this arm's featureCacheKey by design (S3), so its featureKey and identity.runIntentFeatures move with it.
